name: Summon Snake Swarm
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [see text];; Level: bard 2, cleric 2, druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner 2, witch 2

Components: V, S, M/DF (a square of red cloth)

Casting Time: 1 round

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target(s): One snake swarm

Duration: Concentration +2 rounds

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: no

This spell functions like summon swarm, but can only be used to summon a snake swarm (Bestiary 3).
